messages:
anna: Morning — quick async standup. What I did: landed a change to the KV prefetch heuristic and added prefix-hit stats export. Blocker: seeing a 5–10% perf regression on long (2k) traces when microbatching is enabled; looks like contention in the prefetch path. Today: revert to lock-free path for hot keys, run full perf sweep, and open a canary PR for staging.

josh: Can you paste the benchmark delta? is it p99 or throughput?

anna: Quick numbers from the run this AM — p50: +0ms, p95: +12ms, p99: +35ms, throughput: -8% on an 8-GPU cluster. Test command used: `./bench/run.sh --seq 2048 --concurrency 32 --model gpt-like`. Small log excerpt: 
```
2026-03-10T08:12:03Z INFO bench: iter=2000 p95=12.4 p99=35.1 tps=1240
```

priya: Hmm, did prefetch increase eviction churn on the KV cache? last week we saw eviction spikes when speculative prefetching hit low-frequency keys.

anna: Yes — eviction rate for lower-frequency segments is up ~18%. My hypothesis is prefetch is grabbing non-hot keys and causing thrash. Plan: add a bloom-filter-backed candidate filter to avoid prefetching low-frequency keys and instrument per-key heat counters. Sample config proto I tried: 
```json
{"prefetch": {"min_access_count": 3, "use_bloom": true, "bloom_fp_rate": 0.01}}
```
I'll toggle bloom in the canary.

michael: I'll review the PR once you push. Also can we add a canary route in staging that pins the new prefetch and microbatching together? want to watch end-to-end latency + throughput. :thumbsup:

lucy: Heads-up — I pushed a tiny change to the batching scheduler yesterday that uses per-stream token accounting. If you flip back to the lock-free prefetch path, watch out for double-accounting when prefetch populates the stream early. You can disable the stream accounting flag for experiments: `--disable-stream-acc`. Also add this to the canary config to isolate variables.

deploy-bot: CI: build for branch anna/microbatch-prefetch completed — build: PASS, unit: PASS, e2e: FAIL (1 flaky test). Logs: https://ci.redwood.example/annaprefetch/3456

anna: Thanks — I'll re-run e2e and re-run perf with lucy's `--disable-stream-acc` flag. I'll also push a small instrumentation patch for eviction histograms before the canary. Tagging @michael when green. If anyone hits raised p99 on the canary route please @anna immediately. :)

josh: Quick ask — can we do a 30m sync today at 3pm PT if regressions persist? I'd like a quick alignment and to decide rollback thresholds.

priya: I'm in for 3pm, will bring eviction histograms and recent KV heatmaps.
